full_output.key_findings: The study identifies several E. coli genes whose deletions lead to delayed lysis and morphological changes in response to cefsulodin, highlighting the role of lipid metabolism and cell envelope integrity in antibiotic resistance.
full_output.methodology: High-throughput time-resolved microscopy and computational image analysis were used to study morphological changes in E. coli mutants treated with cefsulodin.

full_output.paper_title: Detection of CTX-M-1 extended-spectrum beta-lactamase among ceftiofur-resistant Salmonella enterica clinical isolates of poultry.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the presence of the bla CTX-M-1 gene encoding an extended-spectrum beta-lactamase in ceftiofur-resistant Salmonella enterica isolates from poultry, which confers resistance to several beta-lactam antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: PCR amplification, sequencing, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to characterize the isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Nitroreductases of bacterial origin in Giardia lamblia: Potential role in detoxification of xenobiotics.

NR3.validation_method: functional assays and drug susceptibility tests

full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes NR3, a nitroreductase from Giardia lamblia, which exhibits quinone reductase activity and confers partial resistance to tetracycline in E. coli.
full_output.methodology: Functional assays, drug susceptibility tests, and overexpression experiments in E. coli and G. lamblia.

full_output.paper_title: Resistance of Neisseria gonorrhoeae isolates to beta-lactam antibiotics (benzylpenicillin and ceftriaxone) in Russia, 2015-2017.

mtrR.encodes: transcriptional regulator of the MtrCDE efflux pump
transcriptional regulator of the MtrCDE efflux pump

full_output.key_findings: The study identified mutations in penA, ponA, mtrR, and porB genes, as well as the presence of bla TEM plasmids, which contribute to benzylpenicillin resistance in Neisseria gonorrhoeae isolates from Russia.
full_output.methodology: Microarray hybridization, sequencing, and PCR were used to analyze genetic determinants of resistance in N. gonorrhoeae isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Coexisting Molecular Determinants of Acquired Oxaliplatin Resistance in Human Colorectal and Ovarian Cancer Cell Lines.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified changes in the expression of OCT1, OCT2, OCT3, ATP7A, ATP7B, and ERCC1 as key factors in oxaliplatin resistance, with decreased expression of influx transporters and increased expression of efflux transporters contributing to reduced drug accumulation and resistance.
full_output.methodology: The study used Q-PCR to analyze gene expression and determined cellular oxaliplatin accumulation and DNA adduct formation.

full_output.key_findings: The paper discusses various polymyxin resistance mechanisms, including the identification of mcr-1 to mcr-7 genes in E. coli and K. pneumoniae, which confer resistance to colistin.
full_output.methodology: Experimental validation of polymyxin resistance genes in bacterial strains.

full_output.paper_title: Cefuroxime, levofloxacin, esomeprazole, and bismuth as first-line therapy for eradicating Helicobacter pylori in patients allergic to penicillin.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the efficacy of a cefuroxime, levofloxacin, esomeprazole, and bismuth regimen for eradicating Helicobacter pylori in patients allergic to penicillin, achieving high eradication rates.
full_output.methodology: Prospective cohort study evaluating the efficacy and safety of a quadruple antimicrobial regimen for H. pylori eradication.

full_output.paper_title: Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus among urban rodents, house shrews, and patients in Guangzhou, Southern China.

mecA.mechanism: confers resistance to β-lactam antibiotics by reducing affinity for these drugs
mecA.validation_method: PCR detection of mecA gene and confirmation of methicillin resistance through antibiotic susceptibility testing

full_output.key_findings: The study identified methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) in urban rodents and house shrews in Guangzhou, China, highlighting the potential role of these animals as reservoirs for MRSA strains similar to those found in humans.
full_output.methodology: Bacterial isolation, PCR for mecA detection, antibiotic susceptibility testing, and molecular typing techniques including spa typing and MLST.

full_output.paper_title: Deciphering drug resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis using whole-genome sequencing: progress, promise, and challenges.

katG.evidence_note: The paper states that katG is involved in isoniazid resistance and that mutations in katG lead to decreased drug activation.

ald.evidence_note: loss-of-function mutations in ald (Rv2780), which is predicted to encode an alanine dehydrogenase, correlated with unexplained resistance [25]. They also confirmed experimentally that these mutations conferred increased resistance of laboratory and clinical isolates to D-cycloserine [25]

thyX.evidence_note: The paper mentions that mutations in the thyX promoter are associated with PAS resistance, but does not explicitly state that thyX itself is an acquired AMR gene. It also states that thyX is involved in mitigating target inhibition, which suggests it may be an intrinsic resistance determinant.

full_output.key_findings: The paper discusses the identification of drug resistance determinants in Mycobacterium tuberculosis using whole-genome sequencing, highlighting the importance of mutations in genes such as rpoB, katG, inhA, pncA, embCAB, gyrA, gyrB, atpE, rrs, rpsL, ald, ethA, and thyX. It also identifies new resistance-associated mutations in ethA and the thyX promoter.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing of laboratory-derived resistant mutants and clinical isolates, along with functional validation experiments.

full_output.paper_title: Managing All the Genotypic Knowledge: Approach to a Septic Patient Colonized by Different Enterobacteriales with Unique Carbapenemases.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the presence of bla OXA-48 and bla KPC genes in a patient infected with Raoultella planticola, highlighting the complexity of managing infections caused by multidrug-resistant organisms.
full_output.methodology: PCR, whole-genome sequencing, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to identify and characterize the resistance genes.

full_output.paper_title: Glycine, serine and threonine metabolism confounds efficacy of complement-mediated killing.
full_output.key_findings: The study shows that glycine, serine, and threonine metabolism is down-regulated in serum-resistant E. coli, and exogenous glycine restores serum sensitivity by enhancing complement-mediated killing.
full_output.methodology: Metabolomics, qRT-PCR, and bacterial viability assays were used to investigate the role of glycine, serine, and threonine in serum resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Phenotypic Characterization and Antibiotic Resistance Patterns of Extended-Spectrum β-Lactamase- and AmpC β-Lactamase-Producing Gram-Negative Bacteria in a Referral Hospital, Saudi Arabia.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified a high prevalence of ESBL- and AmpC β-lactamase-producing Gram-negative bacteria, particularly Klebsiella pneumoniae, Escherichia coli, and Acinetobacter spp., in a referral hospital in Saudi Arabia. Coexistence of ESBLs and AmpC β-lactamases was found in 11.6% of isolates, contributing to multidrug resistance.
full_output.methodology: Phenotypic detection of ESBLs and AmpC β-lactamases using double-disk synergy test and inhibitor-based method, along with antimicrobial susceptibility testing via Kirby-Bauer disk diffusion.

full_output.paper_title: New genetic context of lnu(B) composed of two multi-resistance gene clusters in clinical Streptococcus agalactiae ST-19 strains.

lnu(B).evidence_note: lnu(B) was found to be responsible for the L phenotype.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies lnu(B) as the gene responsible for the rare lincosamide resistance (L phenotype) in clinical Streptococcus agalactiae ST-19 strains, highlighting its role in multidrug resistance through a composite transposon structure.
full_output.methodology: PCR, whole genome sequencing, and bioinformatics analysis were used to characterize the genetic context of lnu(B).

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial Activity of Natural Compounds Against Resistant Pathogens
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the NorA efflux pump as a key contributor to antibiotic resistance in Staphylococcus aureus and highlights the potential of natural compounds to inhibit its activity.
full_output.methodology: Experimental analysis of efflux pump inhibition and antimicrobial activity of natural compounds.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular and Phenotypic Characteristics of Escherichia coli Isolates from Farmed Minks in Zhucheng, China.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified qnrS, sul2, and oqxA as the most prevalent resistance genes in E. coli isolates from farmed minks in Zhucheng, China, contributing to multidrug resistance.
full_output.methodology: PCR, sequencing, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to characterize resistance genes and phenotypes in E. coli isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Animal-Use Antibiotics Induce Cross-Resistance in Bacterial Pathogens to Human Therapeutic Antibiotics.
full_output.key_findings: Exposure of bacteria to sub-lethal doses of veterinary antibiotics tilmicosin and florfenicol increases cross-resistance to human therapeutic antibiotics such as ampicillin, tetracycline, and nalidixic acid.
full_output.methodology: MIC determination of antibiotics against various bacterial pathogens after pre-exposure to sub-inhibitory concentrations of tilmicosin and florfenicol.

full_output.paper_title: Clinical and microbiological characteristics and outcomes of community-acquired sepsis among adults: a single center, 1-year retrospective observational cohort study from Hungary.
full_output.key_findings: The study analyzed the clinical and microbiological characteristics of community-acquired sepsis in adults, identifying common causative organisms such as E. coli, S. pneumoniae, and S. aureus. It highlighted the prevalence of sepsis and septic shock, along with the importance of timely and effective antimicrobial therapy.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective observational cohort study analyzing data from adult patients with community-acquired sepsis over a one-year period.

full_output.paper_title: High frequency of the exoU+/exoS+ genotype associated with multidrug-resistant "high-risk clones" of Pseudomonas aeruginosa clinical isolates from Peruvian hospitals.

exoU.encodes: Type III secretion system effector protein

full_output.key_findings: The exoU gene was associated with increased resistance to fluoroquinolones and aminoglycosides in Pseudomonas aeruginosa isolates.
full_output.methodology: PCR, MIC testing, and sequencing were used to analyze the presence of the exoU gene and its association with antimicrobial resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Pollution characteristics of antibiotics and antibiotic resistance of coliform bacteria in the Yitong River, China.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified antibiotic resistance in coliform bacteria in the Yitong River, China, particularly against fluoroquinolones, sulfonamides, tetracyclines, and trimethoprim. The highest detection rates were observed for ofloxacin (OFX) and ciprofloxacin (CIP).
full_output.methodology: The study used solid-phase extraction high-performance liquid chromatography to detect antibiotic concentrations and an improved DST-enzyme substrate method to assess antibiotic resistance of coliform bacteria.
full_output.sample_size: Eight sections of the Yitong River were sampled over three months.

full_output.paper_title: Identification and molecular epidemiology of methicillin resistant Staphylococcus pseudintermedius strains isolated from canine clinical samples in Argentina.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified various AMR genes in methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus pseudintermedius (MRSP) isolates from Argentina, including mecA, blaZ, ermB, dfrG, aph(3')-III, ant(6)-Ia, tetM, and aac(6')-Ie-aph(2')-Ia. Mutations in gyrA (S84L) and grlA (S80I) were associated with ciprofloxacin resistance.
full_output.methodology: PCR, Western blot, whole-genome sequencing, and susceptibility testing were used to identify AMR genes and mutations.

full_output.paper_title: In vitro activities of imipenem, vancomycin, and rifampicin against clinical Elizabethkingia species producing BlaB and GOB metallo-beta-lactamases.

BlaB.validation_method: cloning in E. coli BL21(DE3) + imipenem MIC testing

GOB.validation_method: cloning in E. coli BL21(DE3) + imipenem MIC testing

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies BlaB and GOB metallo-beta-lactamases as the primary cause of imipenem resistance in clinical Elizabethkingia species, with BlaB and GOB showing species-specific variations and differing hydrolysis efficiencies.
full_output.methodology: Cloning and heterologous expression of BlaB and GOB in E. coli, followed by imipenem MIC testing and phylogenetic analysis.

full_output.paper_title: Surprising synergy of dual translation inhibition vs. Acinetobacter baumannii and other multidrug-resistant bacterial pathogens.
full_output.key_findings: The study reveals a strong synergistic effect between azithromycin (AZM) and minocycline (MIN) against multidrug-resistant (MDR) Acinetobacter baumannii and other MDR pathogens, highlighting the importance of media conditions and bicarbonate on antibiotic activity.
full_output.methodology: The study used MIC determination, bactericidal activity assays, mouse pneumonia models, and bacterial cytological profiling to evaluate the synergistic effects of AZM and MIN.

full_output.paper_title: Vancomycin resistance of clinical isolates of lactobacilli.
full_output.key_findings: Two clinical isolates of Lactobacillus casei var rhamnosus were found to be highly resistant to vancomycin, but no inactivation of the antibiotic was demonstrated.
full_output.methodology: Antibiotic susceptibility testing using Stokes' comparative method and macrodilution technique.

full_output.paper_title: In vitro reduction of colistin susceptibility and comparative genomics reveals multiple differences between MCR-positive and MCR-negative colistin-resistant Escherichia coli.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies mutations in pmrA and pmrB genes that contribute to colistin resistance in MCR-negative E. coli mutants, highlighting the role of these genes in the development of resistance.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, PCR, and RT-qPCR were used to identify and validate mutations in pmrA and pmrB genes.
full_output.sample_size: 16 mutants and their corresponding wild-type strains

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence of quinolone-resistant uropathogenic Escherichia coli in a tertiary care hospital in south Iran.
full_output.key_findings: The study found a high prevalence of quinolone resistance among E. coli isolates from UTI patients in southern Iran, with 33.1% positive for qnrS and 12.4% positive for qnrB genes. However, no significant association was found between qnr genes and increased quinolone resistance.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing via disk diffusion and PCR for detection of qnr genes.

full_output.paper_title: Pivmecillinam compared to other antimicrobials for community-acquired urinary tract infections with Escherichia coli, ESBL-producing or not - a retrospective cohort study.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that nitrofurantoin and pivmecillinam had lower resistance rates compared to other antibiotics for treating UTIs caused by ESBL-producing E. coli. Pivmecillinam showed better outcomes for ESBL cases compared to ciprofloxacin and sulfamethizole.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective cohort study analyzing data from the regional Laboratory Database and national databases on antibiotic prescriptions, hospital admissions, and mortality.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular typing revealed the emergence of pvl-positive sequence type 22 methicillin-susceptible Staphylococcus aureus in Urumqi, Northwestern China.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified ST239-MRSA-III-t030 and pvl-positive ST22-MSSA-t309 as the most common clones among S. aureus isolates in Urumqi, with ST239-MRSA showing resistance to multiple antibiotics including PEN, FOX, GEN, LEV, CIP, MXF, RIF, and TET, while ST22-MSSA exhibited resistance to PEN, ERY, and CLI.
full_output.methodology: Molecular typing, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and statistical analysis were performed on 605 S. aureus isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Surface Exclusion Revisited: Function Related to Differential Expression of the Surface Exclusion System of Bacillus subtilis Plasmid pLS20.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies ses_pLS20 as the gene responsible for surface exclusion in the conjugative plasmid pLS20 of Bacillus subtilis, demonstrating its role in preventing redundant transfer of the plasmid.
full_output.methodology: Expression analysis, conjugation assays, and protein localization experiments.

full_output.paper_title: Mutagenesis Induced by Sub-Lethal Doses of Ciprofloxacin: Genotypic and Phenotypic Differences Between the Pseudomonas aeruginosa Strain PA14 and Clinical Isolates.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies differences in mutagenesis and survival between Pseudomonas aeruginosa strain PA14 and clinical isolates when exposed to sub-lethal doses of ciprofloxacin. It reports that clinical isolates show lower mutagenesis and survival compared to PA14-UCBPP, potentially due to mutations in imuB and recX, and the presence of Pyocin S2.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing, mutation frequency analysis, and growth curve experiments were conducted to analyze the effects of sub-lethal ciprofloxacin exposure on P. aeruginosa strains.

full_output.paper_title: Repurposed Antimicrobial Combination Therapy: Tobramycin-Ciprofloxacin Hybrid Augments Activity of the Anticancer Drug Mitomycin C Against Multidrug-Resistant Gram-Negative Bacteria.

MexAB-OprM.notes: Efflux-deficient strains showed increased susceptibility to mitomycin C.

MexCD-OprJ.notes: Efflux-deficient strains showed increased susceptibility to mitomycin C.

MexEF-OprN.notes: Efflux-deficient strains showed increased susceptibility to mitomycin C.

MexJK.notes: Efflux-deficient strains showed increased susceptibility to mitomycin C.

MexXY.notes: Efflux-deficient strains showed increased susceptibility to mitomycin C.

OpmH.notes: Efflux-deficient strains showed increased susceptibility to mitomycin C.

full_output.key_findings: The study shows that the combination of mitomycin C and TOB-CIP enhances antibacterial activity against multidrug-resistant Gram-negative bacteria, particularly highlighting the role of efflux pumps in reducing mitomycin C effectiveness.
full_output.methodology: Microdilution broth susceptibility testing and checkerboard assays were used to assess antimicrobial activity and synergy.

full_output.paper_title: Distribution and Succession Feature of Antibiotic Resistance Genes Along a Soil Development Chronosequence in Urumqi No.1 Glacier of China.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the distribution and succession of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) along a soil development chronosequence in the Urumqi No.1 Glacier, highlighting the presence of multidrug resistance genes like opr J and mex F across all succession ages.
full_output.methodology: High-throughput quantitative PCR (HT-qPCR) was used to detect and quantify ARGs and mobile genetic elements (MGEs) in soil samples.

full_output.paper_title: Decreasing Cell Population of Individual Candida Species Does Not Impair the Virulence of Candida albicans and Candida glabrata Mixed Biofilms.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that the efflux pump genes CA-CDR1, CA-CDR2, CA-MDR1, CG-CDR1, CG-CDR2, and CG-SNQ2 were upregulated in mixed biofilms of Candida albicans and Candida glabrata, indicating increased efflux pump activity and potential resistance to caspofungin.
full_output.methodology: The study used qRT-PCR to analyze the expression of efflux pump genes in single and mixed biofilms of Candida albicans and Candida glabrata.
full_output.sample_size: Eight C. albicans and two C. glabrata strains were used.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence of Antimicrobial Resistance and Virulence Gene Elements of Salmonella Serovars From Ready-to-Eat (RTE) Shrimps.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several AMR genes in Salmonella serovars from RTE shrimps, including blaTEM, catB3, sul2, tmp, strB, dfr1, tetC, flor, class1integrase, and class2integrase. These genes conferred resistance to various antibiotics such as ampicillin, amoxicillin, chloramphenicol, sulfamethoxazole, trimethoprim, streptomycin, tetracycline, and florfenicol.
full_output.methodology: PCR and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to identify and characterize AMR genes in Salmonella isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Antibacterial Effect of Silver Nanoparticles Synthesized Using Murraya koenigii (L.) against Multidrug-Resistant Pathogens.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the antibacterial activity of silver nanoparticles (MK-AgNPs) synthesized using Murraya koenigii against multidrug-resistant pathogens, including ESβL-producing E. coli and MRSA. MK-AgNPs showed significant antibacterial effects, with MIC values ranging from 16 to 64 μg/ml depending on the bacterial strain.
full_output.methodology: The study used UV-vis spectroscopy, FTIR, XRD, SEM, and TEM for characterization of MK-AgNPs, and evaluated their antibacterial activity via agar well diffusion assay, MIC, and MBC determinations.

full_output.paper_title: Extreme Environment Streptomyces: Potential Sources for New Antibacterial and Anticancer Drug Leads?

full_output.methodology: Cloning, functional testing, and biochemical assays were used to validate the roles of the identified genes.

full_output.key_findings: The study found no significant differences in susceptibility of livestock-associated (LA-MRSA), hospital-acquired (HA-MRSA), and community-associated (CA-MRSA) MRSA strains to antiseptics including chlorhexidine, octenidine, polyhexanide, PVP-iodine, and triclosan.
full_output.methodology: The study determined minimal inhibitory concentrations (MICs) and minimal microbicidal concentrations (MBCs) using standardized microbiological methods and quantitative suspension tests.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular epidemiological analysis and risk factors for acquisition of carbapenemase-producing Enterobacter cloacae complex in a Japanese university hospital.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified blaIMP-1 as the primary carbapenemase gene in carbapenemase-producing Enterobacter cloacae complex (CPEC) isolates, highlighting its role in carbapenem resistance and the potential for horizontal transmission through IncHI2A plasmids.
full_output.methodology: PCR, sequencing, REP-PCR, MLST, and whole-genome sequencing were used to analyze carbapenemase genes and molecular epidemiology.

full_output.paper_title: Bloodstream infection with pandrug-resistant Alcaligenes faecalis treated with double-dose of tigecycline.
full_output.key_findings: A case of pandrug-resistant Alcaligenes faecalis bloodstream infection was successfully treated with double-dose tigecycline.
full_output.methodology: Case report and antimicrobial susceptibility testing.

full_output.paper_title: Microbiology and Preclinical Review of Omadacycline.
full_output.key_findings: Omadacycline is a novel aminomethylcycline antimicrobial with potent activity against various gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria, including multidrug-resistant strains. It overcomes common tetracycline resistance mechanisms through structural modifications.
full_output.methodology: In vitro and in vivo studies evaluating the antimicrobial activity and resistance mechanisms of omadacycline.

full_output.paper_title: An integrated respiratory microbial gene catalogue to better understand the microbial aetiology of Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia.

23S rRNA.validation_method: sequencing of 23S rRNA gene in patients treated with macrolides

full_output.key_findings: The study identified a single-nucleotide polymorphism (A2063G) in the 23S rRNA gene of Mycoplasma pneumoniae associated with macrolide resistance in patients treated with macrolides.
full_output.methodology: Metagenomic sequencing and bioinformatics analysis of respiratory samples from children with and without Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia.

full_output.paper_title: Online registry for nationwide database of Helicobacter pylori eradication in Korea: Correlation of antibiotic use density with eradication success.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that the overall eradication rate of first-line therapy for H. pylori was 71.8%, with variations across different regions and treatment regimens. The use of antibiotics, particularly clarithromycin, amoxicillin, and other macrolides, was analyzed, but no direct correlation was found between antibiotic use density and eradication success.
full_output.methodology: The study involved a nationwide registry of H. pylori eradication cases in Korea, analyzing data from 9318 patients across 37 hospitals. The eradication success rates were evaluated based on treatment regimens, patient demographics, and regional antibiotic usage.

full_output.paper_title: The crystal structure of AcrR from Mycobacterium tuberculosis reveals a one-component transcriptional regulation mechanism.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the structural and functional aspects of AcrR, a transcriptional regulator in Mycobacterium tuberculosis, focusing on its role in lipid transport and antibiotic resistance. The research reveals the structural transition of AcrR upon ligand and DNA binding, providing insights into its regulatory mechanism.
full_output.methodology: Structural analysis using X-ray crystallography, NMR spectroscopy, EMSA, and CD spectroscopy.

full_output.paper_title: Proteomic and Morphologic Evidence for Taurine-5-Bromosalicylaldehyde Schiff Base as an Efficient Anti-Mycobacterial Drug.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies NDMA-dependent methanol dehydrogenase, NAD(P)H nitroreductase, and amidohydrolase AmiB1 as critical factors in regulating Mycobacterium smegmatis survival under TBSSB, suggesting their potential as targets for anti-mycobacterial drug development.
full_output.methodology: Proteomic analysis using 2D-gel electrophoresis and mass spectrometry, along with morphological observations using SEM and TEM.

full_output.paper_title: Nutrition Related Stress Factors Reduce the Transfer of Extended-Spectrum Beta-Lactamase Resistance Genes between an Escherichia coli Donor and a Salmonella Typhimurium Recipient In Vitro.

blaCTX-M-1.validation_method: cloning in E. coli + MIC or disk diffusion

full_output.key_findings: The study identified the bla CTX-M-1 gene as a key factor in the transfer of extended-spectrum beta-lactamase resistance between an E. coli donor and a Salmonella Typhimurium recipient, highlighting the impact of nutritional stress factors on conjugation frequencies.
full_output.methodology: The study used in vitro conjugation experiments with an E. coli donor strain carrying the bla CTX-M-1 gene and a Salmonella Typhimurium recipient strain, assessing the impact of various stress factors on conjugation frequencies.

full_output.paper_title: Susceptibility and Multidrug Resistance Patterns of Escherichia coli Isolated from Cloacal Swabs of Live Broiler Chickens in Bangladesh.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified high prevalence of multidrug-resistant Escherichia coli isolates from broiler chickens in Bangladesh, with resistance genes blaTEM, aadA1, ere(A), dfrA1, tet(A), and tet(B) detected.
full_output.methodology: PCR screening and antimicrobial susceptibility testing via Kirby-Bauer disc diffusion method.

full_output.paper_title: Fecal carriage and molecular epidemiology of carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae from outpatient children in Shanghai.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae (CRE) in fecal samples from outpatient children in Shanghai, with blaNDM-1 and blaNDM-5 being the most common carbapenemase genes. Other resistance genes such as blaCTX-M, blaSHV, and blaTEM were also detected.
full_output.methodology: PCR, DNA sequencing, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to identify and characterize AMR genes in CRE isolates.

full_output.paper_title: PK/PD modeling of Ceftiofur Sodium against Haemophilus parasuis infection in pigs.
full_output.key_findings: The study determined the pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics of Ceftiofur Sodium against Haemophilus parasuis in pigs, establishing an in vitro and ex vivo PK/PD model. It found that Ceftiofur Sodium had strong bactericidal activity against H. parasuis with MIC, MBC, and MPC values of 0.003125, 0.0125, and 0.032 μg/mL, respectively. The optimal dose of Ceftiofur Sodium was calculated to be 0.599-1.507 mg/kg.
full_output.methodology: The study used an in vitro and ex vivo PK/PD modeling approach to evaluate the activity of Ceftiofur Sodium against H. parasuis in pigs, measuring pharmacokinetic parameters and determining MIC, MBC, and MPC values.
full_output.sample_size: Twenty healthy Duroc × Landrace × Yorkshire three-way crossbred piglets

full_output.paper_title: Cathepsin L-mediated resistance of paclitaxel and cisplatin is mediated by distinct regulatory mechanisms.

TGF-β.notes: TGF-β is a regulatory factor that activates the TGF-β/smad signaling pathway, which in turn increases CTSL expression and contributes to paclitaxel resistance.

smad3.notes: Smad3 binds to the SBE of the CTSL promoter, increasing CTSL transcription and contributing to paclitaxel resistance.

Egr-1.notes: Egr-1 regulates CTSL promoter activity, contributing to cisplatin resistance.

CREB.notes: CREB binds to the CTSL promoter, increasing CTSL transcription and contributing to cisplatin resistance.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies distinct regulatory mechanisms for CTSL-mediated resistance to paclitaxel and cisplatin. TGF-β and smad3 activate the TGF-β/smad signaling pathway to enhance CTSL expression and contribute to paclitaxel resistance. Egr-1 and CREB regulate CTSL promoter activity, contributing to cisplatin resistance.
full_output.methodology: Western blot, CCK8, flow cytometry, CHIP assay, luciferase assay, and animal experiments were used to validate the regulatory mechanisms of CTSL-mediated drug resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Antibiograms and risk factors of Salmonella isolates from laying hens and eggs in Jimma Town, South Western Ethiopia.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that Salmonella enterica isolates exhibited multidrug resistance, with 72.72% showing resistance to multiple antibiotics. None of the isolates were resistant to Gentamicin, Kanamycin, and Streptomycin.
full_output.methodology: Phenotypic characterization and antimicrobial susceptibility testing using agar diffusion method.

full_output.key_findings: The study describes the synthesis and characterization of Bodipy-FL-cyclosporine A (BD-CsA) as a fluorescent substrate for P-glycoprotein (P-gp). BD-CsA was shown to be transported by both human and mouse P-gp, demonstrating its utility as a sensitive probe for studying P-gp function.
full_output.methodology: Chemical synthesis, flow cytometry, fluorescence microscopy, and in silico docking were used to characterize BD-CsA as a P-gp substrate.

full_output.paper_title: Analysis of lipoprotein transport depletion in Vibrio cholerae using CRISPRi.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified lolC and lptF as essential genes for V. cholerae viability, showing that their depletion leads to severe growth inhibition and cell death.
full_output.methodology: CRISPRi was used to knock down essential genes in V. cholerae, assessing the effects on viability and cellular morphology.

full_output.paper_title: Genome Sequences of Multidrug-Resistant Salmonella enterica Serovar Dublin Isolates.

gyrA.notes: Strains SD_180280 and SD_170735 showed intermediate susceptibility to ciprofloxacin due to gyrA mutations.

full_output.key_findings: Seven multidrug-resistant Salmonella enterica serovar Dublin isolates were sequenced, revealing resistance genes such as blaCMY-2, blaTEM-1B, floR, strA, strB, sul2, tetA, catA1, aadA1, aph(3')-Ic, sul1, and tetB, along with gyrA mutations contributing to fluoroquinolone resistance.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing and bioinformatics analysis were used to identify antimicrobial resistance determinants.

full_output.paper_title: A family of anti-Bacteroidales peptide toxins wide-spread in the human gut microbiota.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies two novel bacteriocins, bacteroidetocin A and B, produced by Bacteroidetes species that target a broad spectrum of Bacteroidales species, including pathogenic Prevotella strains. These toxins are encoded by specific genetic regions and demonstrate potent antimicrobial activity.
full_output.methodology: Genetic analysis, transposon mutagenesis, chemical synthesis, and growth inhibition assays were used to characterize the bacteriocins.

full_output.paper_title: Plant chemical genetics reveals colistin sulphate as a SA and NPR1-independent PR1 inducer functioning via a p38-like kinase pathway.
full_output.key_findings: Colistin sulphate (CS) was identified as a novel exogenous activator of the PR1 defense gene in Arabidopsis, functioning independently of SA and NPR1 through a p38-like kinase pathway.
full_output.methodology: Chemical genetic screening, dose-response assays, GUS activity measurements, and Western blot analysis were used to validate CS's effect on PR1 induction and signaling pathways.

full_output.paper_title: Whole genome sequencing revealed new molecular characteristics in multidrug resistant staphylococci recovered from high frequency touched surfaces in London.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several AMR genes in multidrug-resistant staphylococci from high-frequency touched surfaces in London, including blaZ, qacA/B, dfrC, norA, ant(4')-Ib, AAC(6')-Ie-APH(2")-Ia, fusB, msrA, ermC, mphC, tetK, mupA, cat, dfrG, lnuA, fusC, aph3-IIIa, sat4A, vgaA, and others. These genes conferred resistance to various antibiotics such as penicillin, fusidic acid, mupirocin, tetracycline, erythromycin, and chloramphenicol.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and PCR were used to identify AMR genes in staphylococci isolates.

full_output.paper_title: The increasing threat of silver-resistance in clinical isolates from wounds and burns.
full_output.key_findings: The study reports the first detection of plasmid-mediated silver-resistance genes (sil genes) in clinical isolates of Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Acinetobacter baumannii, and Staphylococcus aureus, along with their detection in Klebsiella pneumoniae, Escherichia coli, and Enterobacter cloacae.
full_output.methodology: PCR, transformation, and MIC testing were used to detect and validate silver-resistance genes.

full_output.key_findings: Fosfomycin showed strong in vitro activity against multidrug-resistant gram-negative bacteria causing urinary tract infections, including ESBL, AmpC, and carbapenemase producers.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing and biofilm formation assessment using agar dilution and tissue culture plate methods.

full_output.paper_title: Community acquired urinary tract infections among adults in Accra, Ghana.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified CTX-M-15 and TEM as the predominant ESBL genes among uropathogens, highlighting the high prevalence of multidrug-resistant Enterobacteriaceae in community-acquired UTIs in Accra, Ghana.
full_output.methodology: Antibiotic susceptibility testing via Kirby-Bauer disc diffusion, PCR for ESBL gene detection, and sequencing for confirmation.

full_output.paper_title: Phenotypic detection of Extended Spectrum β-Lactamases (ESBL) among gram negative uropathogens reveals highly susceptibility to imipenem.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that imipenem was 100% effective against ESBL-producing and non-ESBL-producing Gram-negative isolates from pregnant women with UTIs, highlighting its efficacy as a treatment option.
full_output.methodology: Antibiotic susceptibility testing using the modified Kirby-Bauer method and detection of ESBLs via the Double Disc Synergy Test (DDST).

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence of extensive drug resistance in bacterial isolates harboring blaNDM-1 in Quetta Pakistan.

blaNDM-1.evidence_note: The paper states that blaNDM-1 was detected in Morganella morganii, Enterobacter cloacae, and Citrobacter freundii, and that these isolates showed resistance to carbapenems.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified five blaNDM-1-harboring isolates from three different bacterial species, demonstrating extensive drug resistance (XDR) and pan-drug resistance (PDR).
full_output.methodology: PCR, sequencing, and susceptibility testing were used to identify and characterize blaNDM-1-positive isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Evaluation of resazurin-based rapid test to detect colistin resistance in Acinetobacter baumannii isolates.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated a rapid resazurin-based test for detecting colistin resistance in Acinetobacter baumannii isolates, showing high categorical agreement with conventional methods. None of the colistin-resistant isolates carried plasmid-mediated mcr-1 to mcr-5 genes.
full_output.methodology: The study used a resazurin-based rapid test and compared it with broth microdilution for colistin susceptibility testing.

full_output.paper_title: The impact and mechanism of quaternary ammonium compounds on the transmission of antibiotic resistance genes.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) including qacEΔ1, intI1, and 12 other ARGs (sul1, sul2, cfr, cml, fexA, tetA, tetG, tetQ, tetX, ermB, blaTEM, and dfrA1) in water samples. It also demonstrated that quaternary ammonium compounds (QACs) can increase bacterial resistance to multiple antibiotics and promote the conjugation transfer of plasmids.
full_output.methodology: Quantitative PCR (qPCR) was used to detect ARGs in water samples, and laboratory experiments were conducted to assess the effects of QACs on bacterial resistance and plasmid transfer.

full_output.paper_title: Comparative Epidemiology and Resistance Trends of Proteae in Urinary Tract Infections of Inpatients and Outpatients: A 10-Year Retrospective Study.
full_output.key_findings: The study analyzed the resistance trends of Proteae species, particularly P. mirabilis, P. vulgaris, and Morganella, in urinary tract infections, highlighting high resistance rates to antibiotics such as ciprofloxacin, ceftriaxone, and sulfamethoxazole-trimethoprim.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective analysis of microbiological data from urine samples, including antimicrobial susceptibility testing using disk diffusion and E-test methods.
full_output.sample_size: 21,150 urine samples from outpatient clinics and 19,325 positive samples from inpatient departments

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies an increasing trend in Shigella nonsusceptibility to ciprofloxacin and nalidixic acid in Latin America, particularly among S. flexneri and S. sonnei species.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed aggregated surveillance data from 19 countries in Latin America, using CLSI breakpoints to interpret antimicrobial susceptibility test results.

full_output.paper_title: Erythromycin-resistant lactic acid bacteria in the healthy gut of vegans, ovo-lacto vegetarians and omnivores.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the erm(B) gene as a key determinant of erythromycin resistance in lactic acid bacteria isolated from the guts of vegans, ovo-lacto vegetarians, and omnivores.
full_output.methodology: PCR and MIC determination were used to identify erythromycin-resistant lactic acid bacteria and detect the presence of erm(B) gene.

full_output.paper_title: Multifaceted mechanisms of colistin resistance revealed by genomic analysis of multidrug-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates from individual patients before and after colistin treatment.

mgrB.notes: Insertion of IS Kpn26-like element at nucleotide position 75 of mgrB

phoQ.notes: Multiple missense mutations in phoQ were identified in colistin-susceptible and -resistant isolates.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified the genetic variations responsible for high-level colistin resistance in multidrug-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates, including IS Kpn26-like element insertion in mgrB and various phoQ mutations.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing, PCR amplification, and Sanger sequencing were used to analyze genetic variations and validate mutations.

full_output.paper_title: Identification of Antimicrobial Peptides from the Microalgae Tetraselmis suecica (Kylin) Butcher and Bactericidal Activity Improvement.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) from the microalga Tetraselmis suecica, with AQ-1766 showing strong antibacterial activity against both Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria. Alanine and lysine scans of AQ-1766 revealed modifications that enhanced its antibacterial activity.
full_output.methodology: The study used acid extraction, chromatography, mass spectrometry, and synthetic peptide analysis to characterize AMPs from T. suecica and assess their antibacterial activity.

full_output.paper_title: Carriage of Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus in a Colony of Rhesus (Macaca mulatta) and Cynomolgus (Macaca fascicularis) Macaques.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the presence of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) in a colony of rhesus and cynomolgus macaques, highlighting the carriage rates and the genetic characteristics of the isolates.
full_output.methodology: Nasal cultures, PCR testing for mecA, and molecular typing techniques were used to analyze MRSA carriage and resistance mechanisms.

full_output.paper_title: Biocide-Tolerant Listeria monocytogenes Isolates from German Food Production Plants Do Not Show Cross-Resistance to Clinically Relevant Antibiotics.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified genes such as qacH, emrC, and bcrABC that confer benzalkonium chloride tolerance in L. monocytogenes isolates from German food production plants. These genes were found in 13 out of 15 BAC-tolerant isolates, and no significant association was found between biocide tolerance and antibiotic resistance.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, SNP analysis, and biocide susceptibility testing (MIC and MBC) were used to characterize the isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Typing of mecD Islands in Genetically Diverse Methicillin-Resistant Macrococcus caseolyticus Strains from Cattle.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the methicillin resistance gene mecD in genetically diverse methicillin-resistant Macrococcus caseolyticus strains from cattle, highlighting the presence of different mecD islands (McRI mecD -1, McRI mecD -2, and McRI mecD -3) and their distribution in various sequence types.
full_output.methodology: PCR-based typing, whole-genome sequencing, and bioinformatic analysis were used to characterize the mecD islands and their distribution in M. caseolyticus strains.

full_output.paper_title: Assessing genetic diversity and similarity of 435 KPC-carrying plasmids.

blaKPC.evidence_note: The paper discusses the blaKPC gene as a resistance gene, noting its role in carbapenem resistance and its presence on plasmids.

full_output.key_findings: The study analyzed 435 KPC-carrying plasmids and identified blaKPC as the predominant resistance gene, highlighting the role of transposons like Tn4401 in the spread of carbapenem resistance.
full_output.methodology: The study used bioinformatics approaches including BLAST, clustering algorithms, and annotation tools to analyze plasmid sequences and identify resistance genes.

full_output.paper_title: Characteristics of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus from broiler farms in Germany are rather lineage- than source-specific.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified multiple AMR genes in MRSA isolates from German broiler farms, including tet(K), tet(L), tet(M), erm(B), vga(A), dfrK, spc, and cat(pC221), which confer resistance to tetracycline, MLS B antibiotics, tiamulin, trimethoprim, spectinomycin, and chloramphenicol, respectively.
full_output.methodology: Microarray and PCR analyses were used to characterize AMR genes in MRSA isolates.

full_output.paper_title: ABC Transporter Genes Show Upregulated Expression in Drug-Resistant Clinical Isolates of Candida auris: A Genome-Wide Characterization of ATP-Binding Cassette (ABC) Transporter Genes.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies and characterizes ABC transporter genes in Candida auris, showing that several of these genes are upregulated in drug-resistant isolates and may contribute to azole resistance.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing, quantitative real-time PCR, and phylogenetic analysis were used to identify and characterize ABC transporter genes in C. auris.
full_output.sample_size: 1 type strain and 3 drug-resistant clinical isolates

full_output.paper_title: Human Pleural Fluid Elicits Pyruvate and Phenylalanine Metabolism in Acinetobacter baumannii to Enhance Cytotoxicity and Immune Evasion.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the upregulation of pyruvate dehydrogenase complex subunits AceE and AceF in Acinetobacter baumannii in response to human pleural fluid, suggesting a metabolic adaptation that enhances cytotoxicity and immune evasion.
full_output.methodology: Transcriptomic analysis and qPCR were used to evaluate gene expression changes in A. baumannii under different conditions.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified several AMR genes and mutations in Salmonella enterica strains, including blaTEM-1, aph(3')-I, aph(6')-ld, dfrA5, tetA, and various arsenic resistance genes. A mutation in gyrA was also found to confer nalidixic acid resistance.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing, antibiotic susceptibility testing, and bioinformatic analysis were used to identify AMR genes and mutations.

full_output.paper_title: Commonality of Multidrug-Resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae ST348 Isolates in Horses and Humans in Portugal.

gyrA.notes: Present in isolates C1685 and Kp56

full_output.paper_title: Regulation of Pseudomonas aeruginosa-Mediated Neutrophil Extracellular Traps.

lasR.notes: lasR is a regulatory gene whose mutation leads to reduced NET formation.
lasR.evidence_note: The paper describes a mutation in lasR (in-frame deletion) that leads to reduced NET formation, but does not state that this mutation confers resistance to any antibiotics.

full_output.key_findings: The study shows that the lasR gene is required for robust induction of neutrophil extracellular trap (NET) formation by P. aeruginosa. Mutations in lasR lead to reduced NET formation, indicating its critical role in this process.
full_output.methodology: Genetic manipulation of P. aeruginosa strains, neutrophil isolation, and assessment of NET formation using fluorescence microscopy and flow cytometry.

full_output.paper_title: The Inhibitory Effect of GlmU Acetyltransferase Inhibitor TPSA on Mycobacterium tuberculosis May Be Affected Due to Its Methylation by Methyltransferase Rv0560c.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies Rv0558 and Rv0560c as methyltransferases that can methylate TPSA, reducing its inhibitory effect on GlmU acetyltransferase activity in Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
full_output.methodology: Protein expression, purification, and enzymatic activity assays were used to characterize the function of Rv0558 and Rv0560c.

full_output.paper_title: Fosfomycin Protects Mice From Staphylococcus aureus Pneumonia Caused by α-Hemolysin in Extracellular Vesicles by Inhibiting MAPK-Regulated NLRP3 Inflammasomes.
full_output.key_findings: Fosfomycin inhibits the hemolytic activity of α-hemolysin (Hla) in Staphylococcus aureus, reduces the production of staphylococcal membrane-derived vesicles (SMVs), and inhibits NLRP3 inflammasome activation, thereby protecting mice from S. aureus pneumonia.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing, western blot analysis, molecular dynamics simulations, and in vivo mouse pneumonia models.

full_output.paper_title: Epidemiology Characteristics of Streptococcus pneumoniae From Children With Pneumonia in Shanghai: A Retrospective Study.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the most common serotypes of Streptococcus pneumoniae in children with pneumonia in Shanghai, including 19F, 6A, 19A, 23F, 14, and 6B. It also found that 31.7% of the isolates were penicillin-non-susceptible, with a high rate of resistance to erythromycin and clindamycin. Additionally, the study highlighted the presence of multidrug-resistant (MDR) strains and the emergence of international antibiotic-resistant clones.
full_output.methodology: The study involved serotyping, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, multilocus sequence typing (MLST), and detection of virulence genes through PCR.

full_output.paper_title: First Microbiological and Molecular Identification of Rhodococcus equi in Feces of Nondiarrheic Cats.
full_output.key_findings: The study reports the first microbiological and molecular identification of Rhodococcus equi in the feces of nondiarrheic cats, highlighting the potential risk of transmission of this pathogen to humans. None of the R. equi isolates harbored virulence plasmids associated with pathogenicity.
full_output.methodology: Microbiological and molecular diagnostic techniques were used to identify and characterize R. equi, E. coli, C. perfringens, C. difficile, and Salmonella spp. in fecal samples from nondiarrheic cats.

full_output.paper_title: PAAR proteins act as the 'sorting hat' of the type VI secretion system.
full_output.key_findings: PAAR3 is required for the delivery of VgrG2b and Tle3 by the H2-T6SS, and Tli3 is the cognate immunity protein for Tle3.
full_output.methodology: Competition assays, secretion assays, and heterologous expression experiments.

full_output.paper_title: Combining sequencing approaches to fully resolve a carbapenemase-encoding megaplasmid in a Pseudomonas shirazica clinical strain.

full_output.methodology: Experiments involving zebrafish larvae, mouse cochlear cultures, and rat models to evaluate the protective effects of ORC-13661 against ototoxicity.

mutations_found.validated_by: cryo-EM structures and erythromycin inhibition assays

uL22.notes: The mutation involves a two amino acid deletion in the beta hairpin loop of uL22, leading to resistance to erythromycin.

full_output.key_findings: A two amino acid deletion in the beta hairpin loop of ribosomal protein uL22 in Staphylococcus aureus leads to erythromycin resistance by modulating the exit tunnel, allowing nascent proteins to bypass the drug's steric blockage.
full_output.methodology: Cryo-EM structures and erythromycin inhibition assays were used to characterize the resistance mechanism.

full_output.paper_title: Engineering DNA recognition and allosteric response properties of TetR family proteins by using a module-swapping strategy.

TetR-MphR.notes: Mutants were analyzed for their effects on GFP fluorescence in response to erythromycin.

tetR-mphR.notes: Mutants exhibit altered DNA-binding and allosteric response functions.

full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates the successful engineering of a hybrid TetR-MphR regulator through module-swapping, showing that the hybrid regulator retains DNA-binding and ligand-response properties. Mutations at positions 14, 54, and 55 were identified as affecting the regulator's function.
full_output.methodology: Module-swapping strategy, mutagenesis, fluorescence assays, and gel shift assays were used to analyze the hybrid regulator and its mutants.

full_output.paper_title: Theaflavin-3,3´-digallate increases the antibacterial activity of β-lactam antibiotics by inhibiting metallo-β-lactamase activity.

blaN1.notes: Inhibitory effect of TFDG was reduced

full_output.key_findings: Theaflavin-3,3'-digallate (TFDG) inhibits metallo-beta-lactamase (MBL) activity, enhancing the antibacterial efficacy of beta-lactam antibiotics against MRSA.
full_output.methodology: Nitrocefin assay, molecular dynamics simulation, checkerboard and time-kill assays, mouse infection model.

full_output.paper_title: Involvement of a PadR regulator PrhP on virulence of Ralstonia solanacearum by controlling detoxification of phenolic acids and type III secretion system.
full_output.key_findings: PrhP is a PadR-like regulator that positively regulates the detoxification of salicylic acid (SA) and ferulic acid (FA) and the expression of the type III secretion system (T3SS) in Ralstonia solanacearum, thereby promoting its virulence.
full_output.methodology: Generation of prhP mutants, complementation experiments, promoter activity assays, RNA-seq, and qRT-PCR.

full_output.paper_title: Genetic Diversity and Molecular Epidemiology of Mycobacterium tuberculosis in Roraima State, Brazil.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified mutations in genes associated with resistance to streptomycin, isoniazid, and rifampicin in Mycobacterium tuberculosis isolates from Roraima, Brazil.
full_output.methodology: Sequencing analysis of genes involved in drug resistance and drug susceptibility testing.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies penA and mpl genes as involved in collateral sensitivity in Burkholderia multivorans, with penA mutations linked to ceftazidime resistance and mpl mutations linked to meropenem resistance.
full_output.methodology: Genomic analysis and mutational analysis of evolved strains.

full_output.paper_title: Phenotypic and genetic differences among group B Streptococcus recovered from neonates and pregnant women in Shenzhen, China: 8-year study.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified ermB, mefA/E, lnuB, tetO, and tetM as the main resistance genes in Group B Streptococcus (GBS) isolates from neonates and pregnant women in Shenzhen, China. These genes conferred resistance to erythromycin, clindamycin, and tetracycline.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed GBS isolates from neonates and pregnant women using antimicrobial susceptibility testing, PCR for resistance and virulence genes, and MLST for genotyping.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified mecA and femX as key genes contributing to amoxicillin resistance in Staphylococcus aureus, with their expression levels correlating with resistance development.
full_output.methodology: The study used a rabbit tissue cage infection model, RT-qPCR, and gene expression analysis to investigate amoxicillin resistance mechanisms in S. aureus.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular Epidemiology of Multidrug-Resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae Isolates in a Brazilian Tertiary Hospital.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified various AMR genes and mutations in multidrug-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates, including bla KPC, bla CTX-M, bla TEM, and mutations in ompk35, ompk36, gyrA, and parC. These findings highlight the complex resistance mechanisms contributing to the persistence of MDR-Kp in the hospital setting.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, PCR, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to identify AMR genes and mutations in K. pneumoniae isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Characterization of PAN-1, a Carbapenem-Hydrolyzing Class B β-Lactamase From the Environmental Gram-Negative Pseudobacteriovorax antillogorgiicola.

blaPAN-1.validation_method: cloning in E. coli + MIC testing

full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes PAN-1, a novel class B metallo-beta-lactamase from the environmental bacterium Pseudobacteriovorax antillogorgiicola, which hydrolyzes various beta-lactams including carbapenems but not cefepime or aztreonam.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing, cloning, protein purification, and enzymatic activity assays.

full_output.paper_title: Evaluation of the Antimicrobial Peptide, RP557, for the Broad-Spectrum Treatment of Wound Pathogens and Biofilm.
full_output.key_findings: RP557 is a designed antimicrobial peptide with broad-spectrum activity against Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria, fungi, and biofilms. It showed no resistance development in P. aeruginosa and S. aureus after 30 passages and effectively disrupted biofilms.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial activity, resistance development, and biofilm disruption were evaluated using MIC assays, time-kill assays, and in vivo murine wound infection models.

full_output.paper_title: A putative enoyl-CoA hydratase contributes to biofilm formation and the antibiotic tolerance of Achromobacter xylosoxidans.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies echA, a putative enoyl-CoA hydratase, as a gene contributing to biofilm formation and antibiotic tolerance in Achromobacter xylosoxidans.
full_output.methodology: Transposon mutagenesis, biofilm assays, and genetic complementation were used to investigate the role of echA in biofilm formation and antibiotic tolerance.

full_output.key_findings: The paper introduces Meta-MARC, a computational method using hierarchical Hidden Markov Models to detect diverse antimicrobial resistance sequences with higher sensitivity than existing methods.
full_output.methodology: The paper evaluates Meta-MARC's performance using simulated data, functional metagenomic datasets, and shotgun metagenomic data.

full_output.paper_title: Genomic analysis of Staphylococcus capitis isolated from blood cultures in neonates at a neonatal intensive care unit in Sweden.

nsr.evidence_note: The nsr gene coding for nisin resistance was established using in silico PCR with primers previously described.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified the NRCS-A clone of Staphylococcus capitis as a multidrug-resistant strain prevalent in neonatal intensive care units in Sweden. Key genetic traits associated with the NRCS-A clone include the nsr gene for nisin resistance, ebh, tarJ, and CRISPR elements.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, cgMLST, SNP-based phylogenetic analysis, and in silico predictions were used to analyze the genetic characteristics of S. capitis isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Dually Acting Nonclassical 1,4-Dihydropyridines Promote the Anti-Tuberculosis (Tb) Activities of Clofazimine.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies nonclassical 1,4-dihydropyridines that enhance the anti-tuberculosis activity of clofazimine by inhibiting the ABCB1 efflux pump in Mycobacterium tuberculosis, thereby increasing drug toxicity and preventing resistance development.
full_output.methodology: Synthesis of 1,4-dihydropyridines, evaluation of their antituberculostatic activity, ABCB1 inhibitory activity, and drug toxicity enhancement effects in combination with clofazimine.

full_output.paper_title: The ADEP Biosynthetic Gene Cluster in Streptomyces hawaiiensis NRRL 15010 Reveals an Accessory clpP Gene as a Novel Antibiotic Resistance Factor.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies clpP_ADEP as a novel antibiotic resistance gene in Streptomyces hawaiiensis NRRL 15010, which confers high-level resistance to ADEP antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing, heterologous expression, and bioassays were used to identify and validate the role of clpP_ADEP in ADEP resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Complementary Antibacterial Effects of Bacteriocins and Organic Acids as Revealed by Comparative Analysis of Carnobacterium spp. from Meat.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies several bacteriocins, including carnobacteriocin BM1, B2, divergicin A, and carnolysin, produced by Carnobacterium spp. from meat, highlighting their antibacterial activities against Gram-positive bacteria.
full_output.methodology: Genomic analysis and phenotypic characterization of 31 Carnobacterium strains.

full_output.paper_title: The VirAB-VirSR-AnrAB Multicomponent System Is Involved in Resistance of Listeria monocytogenes EGD-e to Cephalosporins, Bacitracin, Nisin, Benzalkonium Chloride, and Ethidium Bromide.

VirAB.mechanism: resistance to cephalosporins, bacitracin, nisin, ethidium bromide, and benzalkonium chloride
VirAB.validation_method: gene deletion mutants and complementation experiments

AnrAB.mechanism: resistance to cephalosporins, bacitracin, nisin, ethidium bromide, and benzalkonium chloride
AnrAB.validation_method: gene deletion mutants and complementation experiments

full_output.key_findings: The VirAB-VirSR-AnrAB system is involved in resistance of Listeria monocytogenes EGD-e to cephalosporins, bacitracin, nisin, benzalkonium chloride, and ethidium bromide. VirAB is responsible for antimicrobial sensing and signaling, while AnrAB contributes to antimicrobial detoxification.
full_output.methodology: Gene deletion mutants, complementation experiments, MIC determination, RT-qPCR, and β-galactosidase assays.

full_output.paper_title: Protein determinants of dissemination and host specificity of metallo-β-lactamases.

blaNDM-1.validation_method: expression in bacterial hosts and measurement of MICs

blaVIM-2.validation_method: expression in bacterial hosts and measurement of MICs

blaSPM-1.validation_method: expression in bacterial hosts and measurement of MICs

blaIMP-1.validation_method: expression in different bacterial hosts and assessment of growth defects

blaVIM-1.validation_method: expression in different bacterial hosts and assessment of growth defects

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies blaNDM-1, blaVIM-2, and blaSPM-1 as metallo-beta-lactamase genes that confer resistance to carbapenems. The expression of these genes in different bacterial hosts leads to varying fitness costs, influencing their dissemination and host specificity.
full_output.methodology: Expression of MBL genes in various bacterial hosts followed by measurement of MICs and analysis of protein localization and secretion.

full_output.key_findings: The study describes the development of metallogels incorporating antimicrobial metal ions (Fe III, Cu II, Co II, Ni II, Zn II) for wound dressings, demonstrating their ability to release metal ions in response to pH and H2O2, which are present in infected wounds. These metallogels show antimicrobial activity against E. coli, S. aureus, and S. epidermidis.
full_output.methodology: Synthesis of metallogels via co-gelation of tannic acid and titanium ions, incorporation of antimicrobial metal ions, evaluation of metal ion release profiles, and assessment of antimicrobial efficacy through MIC tests and disc diffusion assays.

full_output.paper_title: Coagulation factors VII, IX and X are effective antibacterial proteins against drug-resistant Gram-negative bacteria.
full_output.key_findings: The light chains of coagulation factors VII, IX, and X (lFVII, lFIX, lFX) exhibit potent antibacterial activity against drug-resistant Gram-negative bacteria by hydrolyzing lipopolysaccharides (LPS) in the bacterial cell envelope.
full_output.methodology: Antibacterial activity was assessed using growth kinetic measurements, SEM, and mass spectrometry techniques.
full_output.sample_size: various bacterial strains including clinical isolates

full_output.paper_title: Acidic pH promotes lipopolysaccharide modification and alters colonization in a bacteria-animal mutualism.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies eptA as a gene that confers resistance to polymyxin B in Vibrio fischeri by modifying lipid A with ethanolamine, enhancing resistance under acidic pH conditions.
full_output.methodology: Genetic screening, qRT-PCR, lipid A analysis by MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry, and complementation experiments.

full_output.key_findings: Imipenem/relebactam (IMI/REL) was found to be an effective treatment for carbapenem-nonsusceptible gram-negative infections, with comparable efficacy to colistin-based therapy but significantly lower nephrotoxicity.
full_output.methodology: Randomized, double-blind, phase 3 trial comparing IMI/REL with colistin plus imipenem in patients with imipenem-nonsusceptible bacterial infections.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular Epidemiology of Ceftriaxone Non-Susceptible Enterobacterales Isolates in an Academic Medical Center in the United States.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified various extended-spectrum beta-lactamase (ESBL) and plasmid-mediated ampC (p-ampC) genes in ceftriaxone-non-susceptible Enterobacterales isolates, highlighting the diversity of resistance mechanisms.
full_output.methodology: DNA microarray-based assay to detect beta-lactamase genes in clinical isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Diversity of clonal types of Klebsiella pneumoniae causing infections in intensive care neonatal patients in a large urban setting.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified bla CTX-M-15 and bla CTX-M-2 genes in Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates from neonatal intensive care units, which confer resistance to various beta-lactam antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: The study used PCR, disk diffusion tests, MLST, and ERIC-PCR to characterize the genetic diversity and resistance mechanisms of Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Antibiotic resistance and inhibition mechanism of novel aminoglycoside phosphotransferase APH(5) from B. subtilis subsp. subtilis strain RK

APH(5).validation_method: purification and characterization via ion exchange chromatography, coupled spectrophotometric assay, and HPLC analysis
APH(5).source: Bacillus subtilis subsp. subtilis strain RK
APH(5).evidence_note: The paper describes the isolation and characterization of APH(5) from Bacillus subtilis subsp. subtilis strain RK, which confers resistance to streptomycin through phosphorylation.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies a novel aminoglycoside phosphotransferase, APH(5), from Bacillus subtilis subsp. subtilis strain RK, which confers resistance to streptomycin by phosphorylating the 5-OH group of the streptamine ring.
full_output.methodology: Purification of APH(5) using ion exchange chromatography, coupled spectrophotometric assay, and HPLC analysis to confirm its activity and resistance mechanism.

full_output.paper_title: Synthesis and enzyme-based evaluation of analogues L-tyrosine thiol carboxylic acid inhibitor of metallo-β-lactamase IMP-1.
full_output.key_findings: The study focused on synthesizing and evaluating L-tyrosine thiol carboxylic acid analogues as inhibitors of the metallo-beta-lactamase IMP-1, which is responsible for resistance to beta-lactam antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: The study involved the synthesis of compounds, computational modeling, and enzyme kinetics studies to evaluate their inhibitory activity against IMP-1.

full_output.paper_title: Chemical Induction of Aminoglycoside Uptake Overcomes Antibiotic Tolerance and Resistance in Staphylococcus aureus.
full_output.key_findings: The study shows that rhamnolipids (RLs) enhance aminoglycoside uptake in Staphylococcus aureus, overcoming antibiotic tolerance and resistance by enabling PMF-independent drug entry. RLs also re-sensitize resistant isolates and reduce the development of resistance.
full_output.methodology: The study used bacterial growth experiments, MIC assays, and synergy tests to evaluate the effect of RLs on aminoglycoside efficacy.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence, Genotypic Characteristics and Antibiotic Resistance of Listeria monocytogenes From Retail Foods in Bulk in Zhejiang Province, China.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified tetracycline resistance in Listeria monocytogenes isolates from retail foods in Zhejiang Province, China.
full_output.methodology: Antibiotic susceptibility tests and molecular analysis were used to determine resistance profiles and genotypic characteristics of L. monocytogenes isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Tanshinones: First-in-Class Inhibitors of the Biogenesis of the Type 3 Secretion System Needle of Pseudomonas aeruginosa for Antibiotic Therapy.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies tanshinones as first-in-class inhibitors of the biogenesis of the type 3 secretion system (T3SS) needle in Pseudomonas aeruginosa, demonstrating their ability to block T3SS function and reduce bacterial virulence without inducing antibiotic resistance.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized a fluorescence polarization-based high-throughput screening assay to identify tanshinones as competitive inhibitors of PscF binding to PscE-PscG, along with biochemical and in vitro/in vivo functional assays to validate their efficacy.

full_output.paper_title: Vancomycin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus isolated from camel meat and slaughterhouse workers in Egypt.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified vancomycin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (VRSA) in camel meat and slaughterhouse workers in Egypt, with all VRSA isolates carrying both vanA and vanB genes.
full_output.methodology: PCR amplification and sequencing of vanA and vanB genes in vancomycin-resistant S. aureus isolates.
full_output.sample_size: 200 camel meat samples and 20 human hand swabs

full_output.paper_title: Genomic Sequence Analysis of the Multidrug-Resistance Region of Avian Salmonella enterica serovar Indiana Strain MHYL.

organisms_tested_in: Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Indiana
blaTEM.validation_method: Southern blot hybridization and gene sequencing

tetA.validation_method: Southern blot hybridization and gene sequencing

floR.validation_method: Southern blot hybridization and gene sequencing

organisms_tested_in: Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Indiana

full_output.key_findings: The study identified several AMR genes, including blaTEM, strA, tetA, floR, and aac(6')-Ib-cr, in the multidrug-resistant Salmonella enterica serovar Indiana strain MHYL. These genes were localized in two distinct MDR regions, RR1 and RR2, and were associated with resistance to multiple antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing, Southern blot hybridization, and gene annotation were used to identify and characterize the AMR genes in the MHYL strain.

full_output.paper_title: First-In-Class Inhibitors Targeting the Interaction between Bacterial RNA Polymerase and Sigma Initiation Factor Affect the Viability and Toxin Release of Streptococcus pneumoniae.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies C3-005 as a novel inhibitor targeting the interaction between bacterial RNA polymerase and sigma initiation factor, showing improved antimicrobial activity against Streptococcus pneumoniae and other Gram-positive pathogens.
full_output.methodology: The study involved the synthesis and evaluation of C3 derivatives, including determination of MIC, protein-protein interaction inhibition assays, time-kill kinetics, ATP production assessment, and toxin secretion analysis.

full_output.paper_title: Biological Characterization and Inhibition of Streptococcus pyogenes ZUH1 Causing Chronic Cystitis by Crocus sativus Methanol Extract, Bee Honey Alone or in Combination with Antibiotics: An In Vitro Study.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified virulence genes (spyCEP, ssa, sic, sdaB, and speG) in the S. pyogenes ZUH1 strain and evaluated the anti-streptococcal activity of Crocus sativus methanol extract, bee honey, and catfish glycoprotein, showing their effectiveness in inhibiting the strain.
full_output.methodology: The study used PCR for molecular identification, disc diffusion assays for antibiotic susceptibility, and TEM for analyzing the effects of natural agents on S. pyogenes cells.

full_output.paper_title: Antibiotic Resistance, Virulence Factors, Phenotyping, and Genotyping of E. coli Isolated from the Feces of Healthy Subjects.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that most E. coli strains isolated from healthy subjects were highly susceptible to antibiotics, with only two strains showing resistance to gentamycin and ciprofloxacin. No specific AMR genes were experimentally validated in this study.
full_output.methodology: The study used molecular fingerprinting, PCR, and antibiotic susceptibility testing to analyze E. coli strains.

full_output.paper_title: 4-Amino-2-Sulfanylbenzoic Acid as a Potent Subclass B3 Metallo-β-Lactamase-Specific Inhibitor Applicable for Distinguishing Metallo-β-Lactamase Subclasses.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies 4-amino-2-sulfanylbenzoic acid (ASB) as a potent inhibitor of subclass B3 metallo-β-lactamases, including SMB-1, AIM-1, and L1, demonstrating its effectiveness in reducing meropenem MICs in bacterial strains producing these enzymes.
full_output.methodology: In silico screening, in vitro inhibition assays, X-ray crystallography, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to evaluate the inhibitory activity of ASB against metallo-β-lactamases.

full_output.key_findings: The study compared the real-world use of ceftaroline and vancomycin for treating acute bacterial skin and skin structure infections (ABSSSI) and found no significant difference in infection-related length of stay (LOS inf) between the two treatments.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective, multicenter, cohort study analyzing data from patients treated with ceftaroline or vancomycin for ABSSSI.

full_output.paper_title: Spread of NDM-5 and OXA-181 Carbapenemase-Producing Escherichia coli in Chad.
full_output.key_findings: The study detected blaNDM-5 and blaOXA-181 in Escherichia coli isolates from Chad, highlighting their presence on IncX3 and IncF plasmids, and emphasizing the need for improved infection control measures.
full_output.methodology: PCR, sequencing, and plasmid analysis were used to identify and characterize the resistance genes.

full_output.paper_title: Identification of New MmpL3 Inhibitors by Untargeted and Targeted Mutant Screens Defines MmpL3 Domains with Differential Resistance.

mmpL3.notes: Mutations in mmpL3 were identified through genomic sequencing of resistant mutants.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified four new MmpL3 inhibitors and characterized resistance mutations in mmpL3 that confer differential resistance to these inhibitors.
full_output.methodology: Genomic sequencing, dose-response curves, lipid accumulation assays, and competitive binding assays were used to characterize MmpL3 inhibitors and resistance mutations.

full_output.paper_title: Pyrrolomycins Are Potent Natural Protonophores.

mdtP.notes: Overexpression of mdtP due to promoter derepression leads to pyrrolomycin resistance.

slyA.notes: Mutations in slyA contribute to low-level pyrrolomycin resistance in E. coli.

ompA.notes: A mutation in ompA contributes to low-level pyrrolomycin resistance in E. coli.
ompA.evidence_note: The paper states that a mutation in ompA (G63R) is located in the second transmembrane β-barrel of the protein and that this mutation is associated with low-level pyrrolomycin resistance in E. coli.

mprF.notes: Mutations in mprF contribute to pyrrolomycin resistance in S. aureus.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies mdtP overexpression and mutations in slyA, ompA, and mprF as mechanisms of pyrrolomycin resistance in E. coli and S. aureus.
full_output.methodology: Genetic engineering, whole-genome sequencing, and MIC testing were used to characterize resistance mechanisms.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular characteristics, pathogenicity and medication regimen of Aeromonas hydrophila isolated from common carp (Cyprinus carpio L.).
full_output.key_findings: The study identified that the A. hydrophila strain AhHN1 exhibits multidrug resistance, being resistant to several antibiotics including balofloxacin, florfenicol, gentamicin, kanamycin, streptomycin, ceftriaxone, neomycin sulfate, amoxicillin, ampicillin, penicillin G, sulfamethazine, sulfamethoxazole, and sulfadiazine, but shows extreme sensitivity to enrofloxacin.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing was performed using the broth microdilution method, and the minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) and minimum bactericidal concentration (MBC) were determined.

full_output.paper_title: Resistance mechanisms and molecular epidemiology of carbapenem-nonsusceptible Escherichia coli in Taiwan, 2012-2015.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several carbapenemase genes, including blaNDM-1, blaNDM-5, blaKPC-2, blaIMP-8, blaVIM-1, blaOXA-48, and blaOXA-181, along with the CMY-2 AmpC beta-lactamase, as key resistance mechanisms in carbapenem-nonsusceptible E. coli in Taiwan. The most prevalent resistance mechanism involved the combination of CMY-2 and porin loss (OmpF and OmpC).
full_output.methodology: PCR, MLST, PFGE, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to identify resistance mechanisms and molecular epidemiology.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial resistance pattern and molecular genetic distribution of metallo-β-lactamases producing Pseudomonas aeruginosa isolated from hospitals in Minia, Egypt.

blaIMP.evidence_note: The paper states that blaIMP was detected in 42.8% (nine of 21) of carbapenem-resistant P. aeruginosa isolates.

blaVIM.evidence_note: The paper states that bla VIM was detected in 52.3% (eleven of 21) of carbapenem-resistant isolates.

blaGIM.evidence_note: The paper mentions that blaGIM was detected in 52.3% (eleven of 21) of carbapenem-resistant isolates.

blaSPM.evidence_note: The paper mentions that blaSPM was detected in 38% (8/21) of carbapenem-resistant P. aeruginosa isolates.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified several metallo-beta-lactamase (MBL) genes, including bla IMP, bla VIM, bla GIM, and bla SPM, as well as the extended-spectrum beta-lactamase gene bla CTX-M15, in carbapenem-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa isolates from hospitals in Minia, Egypt.
full_output.methodology: PCR and sequencing were used to detect and characterize MBL and ESBL genes in P. aeruginosa isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Extended-Spectrum Beta-Lactamase-production in Escherichia coli isolated from door handles in Nasarawa State University, Keffi, Nigeria.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified blaTEM and blaSHV genes as the primary extended-spectrum beta-lactamase (ESBL) genes in E. coli isolates from door handles in Nasarawa State University, Keffi, Nigeria. blaCTX-M was not detected in any of the isolates.
full_output.methodology: PCR amplification and gel electrophoresis for detection of ESBL genes.

full_output.paper_title: Genetic Characterization and Enhanced Surveillance of Ceftriaxone-Resistant Neisseria gonorrhoeae Strain, Alberta, Canada, 2018.
